notes: Adapted from the fork's single shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json). Kept Immolate maintenance, the Shadowburn execute, and Life Tap; moved the Shadowburn execute condition from a fixed remaining-fight-time check to isExecutePhase(E20), matching the target-health idiom used elsewhere in this lane rather than only firing at the very end of a fight. Amplify Curse and Demonic Sacrifice were dropped: Destruction does not talent into either. Immolate is now cast at prepull so the DoT is already ticking when the fight opens. Conflagrate and Incinerate (412758) are Forever's own Destruction talents and both require Immolate on the target. Fix round 1: Incinerate is not registered anywhere in sim/warlock (it exists only in the talent-tree metadata table, no spell file, no ActionID) -- it was this file's only unconditional filler with nothing beneath it, so once Immolate was up and Conflagrate on cooldown this rotation had nothing left to cast. The Incinerate line is kept (it is the guide's own placement of Destruction's signature filler) and Shadow Bolt (25307, corrected to the build's current top rank 10 from the shared preset's stale rank 9) is added beneath it as the engine-castable Era filler, so the rotation still deals damage today and upgrades itself once Incinerate lands. An earlier draft of these notes claimed the Shadow Bolt rank fix had already been made in this file; it had not -- Shadow Bolt had been removed outright rather than rank-corrected, which this fix round corrects by actually adding it. Fix round 3: Conflagrate was cast as 1293817, the id the Forever talent-tree metadata table carries; sim/warlock/conflagrate.go registers the vanilla ids 17962/18930/18931/18932 instead, and 1293817 is cast by nothing. All four vanilla ids are in this build's spellconst, so the line now names 18932 (spellconst rank 6), the highest one registered at level 60 -- not declared inert, since it is a real, engine-castable Conflagrate, just talent-gated like Shadowburn beneath it. Every rank named here (other than the flagged inert Incinerate line) is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/. Rotation-accuracy program fix round (2026-09-28): Incinerate is no longer inert -- sim/warlock/incinerate.go registers it for real now, talent- and level-gated (see the priority list's own updated note on that line) -- and Shadow Bolt below it is now gated on spellIsKnown(412758) so it yields once Incinerate is taken instead of sitting permanently unreachable beneath an unconditional Incinerate cast. Rotation-accuracy program diagnosis, inert 18867 (2026-09-28): Shadowburn is talent-gated (sim/warlock/shadowburn.go's registerShadowBurnSpell returns immediately without warlock.Talents.Shadowburn), same as Conflagrate above. spellranks.json records rank 2 (18867) as learnable from level 24 with no talent information at all, so the ladder's own above-band-rank exemption (rankLevelByID) does not apply once the character is past level 24 -- but the truncated talent build has not yet spent Shadowburn's own talent point at level 30, so the engine legitimately does not register any rank yet. Fix round: not declared inert after all -- the pinned engine resolves 18867 fine once both level 24 and the Shadowburn talent are met (declaring it inert would wrongly tell the level-60 zero-talent smoke test to expect it unresolved, which it is not, since spellranks.json alone -- ignoring the talent -- already treats a level-60 character as having every rank). Fixed instead in sim/request/ladder.go: expandTalentSpellIDs widens the harness's zero-points exemption from talents.json's single named id per node (17877 only) to every id spellranks.json's own 'Shadowburn' rank grouping shares with it, so rank 2 (18867) is recognized as gated by the same talent rank 1 is. Rotation-accuracy audit, engine numbers (2026-09-28): sim/warlock/conflagrate.go's ranks 3-6 (17962/18930/18931/18932, the ones with a Classic precedent) carried the classic tooltip's min/max roll (e.g. rank 6 {447, 557}) instead of spellconst/warlock.json's own flat rank-6 amount (282) -- roughly half, the same halving Shadow Bolt, Searing Pain, Soul Fire, Shadowburn, Corruption, Bane of Agony and Immolate all carried; fixed in the fork with a regression test each (commit 34803746d). Ranks 1-2 (1293817/1293818, no Classic precedent) were already flat and correct. This is why this spec's DPS dropped in this round's golden refresh -- the cast set and priority order are unchanged. Rotation-accuracy program, wand-weaving addition (2026-09-28): Shoot (5019) is declared inert because this build's item table has no wand with required_level <= 10, so the ladder's level-10 rung equips nothing in the ranged slot and core.RegisterShootSpell never registers the spell there; from level 20 on it resolves and fires heavily (up to 74 percent of top casts) alongside Life Tap on this bare, no-consumes, no-buffs ladder character. Rotation search (2026-10-06, level 60, 800 iterations, seed 7): Corruption is added at the top, Immolate is recast under 3 seconds remaining, Shadowburn loses its execute gate, and the wand gate moved from 20 to 40 percent mana; about +21 percent in that run. The search's second Corruption line was dead (same condition as the first) and is collapsed away.

engineering_notes.4: The fork's own shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json) already maintains this curse for every spec -- only Affliction's own maintenance kept it after the three files were split apart.
engineering_notes.6: Fix round 3: cast as 18932 rank 6, the highest of the vanilla ids sim/warlock/conflagrate.go actually registers (17962/18930/18931/18932), not 1293817 -- the id the Forever talent-tree metadata table carries, which nothing in sim/warlock ever casts. Talent-gated (sim/warlock/conflagrate.go's registerConflagrateSpell returns immediately without warlock.Talents.Conflagrate), so it stays unresolved under this build's no-talent smoke run the same way Shadowburn below does.
engineering_notes.8: Rotation-accuracy program fix round: sim/warlock/incinerate.go now registers Incinerate for real (talent-gated on warlock.Talents.Incinerate, level-gated 40/50/60 per rank) -- the 'inert, no spell registration' note above this line described an earlier engine state and is stale; the ladder's own cast sets show 412758/1293812/1293813 actually firing at level 38+ once the truncated build's talent walk reaches Incinerate's row.
engineering_notes.9: This line always sat directly beneath Incinerate's unconditional cast, so once Incinerate stopped being inert it claimed every GCD Shadow Bolt used to get, leaving Shadow Bolt's own authored id a zero_casts ladder violation at every level from 40 on -- not a bug in Shadow Bolt, just an unreachable line now that the ability above it always wins. Gated on spellIsKnown(412758), the same not-spellIsKnown shape rogue-subtlety's Sinister Strike/Hemorrhage line and mage-fire's Improved Scorch/Fireball line use.

expected_idle.reason: Shadow Bolt is gated `not spellIsKnown(412758)`, the pre-Incinerate filler (see the priority list's own note on this line and on Incinerate above it). At every level this ladder's own zero_casts check flags it (40+), Incinerate is already known and correctly claims the filler slot instead -- the ladder's own cast sets confirm 412758/1293812/1293813 firing at those levels. The fallback yielding as designed, not a defect, the same shape as rogue-subtlety's Sinister Strike/Hemorrhage line.

priorityList.notes: Corruption goes down first and is kept up throughout: it is cheap sustained damage that does not compete with your casts.
Potion at the top of the fight if mana is already below 75 percent.
Life Tap to keep casting once mana runs low.
Bane of Agony ramps up over its duration, so it goes down first and is refreshed the moment it drops. It is not a spec-locked ability -- every Warlock spec keeps this curse up.
Immolate is the DoT both Conflagrate and Incinerate need on the target, so it is recast when under 3 seconds remain.
Conflagrate consumes part of Immolate's remaining damage as instant burst; only worth casting while Immolate is up. It requires the Conflagrate talent.
Shadowburn is cast on cooldown whenever its reagent cost is acceptable, with no execute-phase gate: it is strong burst at any target health.
Incinerate is Destruction's signature filler, dealing bonus damage while Immolate is active. It requires the Incinerate talent, learned at level 40 and ranking up at 50 and 60.
Shadow Bolt is the filler while you have not yet learned the Incinerate talent (or have not reached its level-40 requirement); once you have, Incinerate takes priority instead.
Shoot with your wand once mana is under 40 percent: it costs nothing, so mana regenerates while it keeps damage going. Life Tap is only the backstop below 10 percent.
